model.name: R20.3: All item views default to COLLAPSED on render — always, every load.
model.description: EVERYTHING defaults to COLLAPSED on render — including the Room root node itself. The full expand sequence is: tap Room → Members/Files folder nodes appear (collapsed) → tap folder → items appear (collapsed) → tap item → children appear. NO auto-expand at any level. Collapsed = children/subtree HIDDEN (expander ">" closed), item shows full card (icon+name+desc). NOT icon-only compact (that is a separate state per item-view-states standard). iOS: oi-icon cursor:grab must not suppress tap-to-expand on iOS Safari.
model.tronQuote:
> TRON: "make all itemviews by default collapsed… always."
> TRON (clarification): "collapsed means no children visible not icon only."
> TRON (FINAL): default = EVERYTHING collapsed incl Room root.

intendedChain.useCase: itemView.defaultCollapsed — on fresh render all item views are collapsed
intendedChain.method: render / initCollapsed — set collapsed=true as the default state before first paint
intendedChain.implementation: constructor or connectedCallback sets this.collapsed=true; render reads it; no auto-expand
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) fresh page load → Room root node is collapsed (no children visible). Tap Room → Members+Files folders appear, both collapsed. Tap folder → items appear, all collapsed. Currently FAILS (some levels auto-expanded). (2) iOS Safari: tap expander on collapsed item → children appear (cursor:grab fix).

model.crossRefNote: R19.27 (icon-tap collapses width to square) defined the collapse interaction. R20.3 sets the DEFAULT state to collapsed — items start collapsed and user expands, not the reverse.
